data.name: Iqmal
data.gender_notes: Iqmal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘iqamah’ which means 'to establish' or 'to establish prayer'. The name Iqmal symbolizes victory and triumph over challenges and hardships in life, as well as in the spiritual realm. The name Iqmal carries the meaning “Victory, Triumph” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Iqmal usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, triumph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Victory in the path of righteousness and faith
data.etymology: Iqmal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory, Triumph.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqmal total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إقمال

in_english.name: Iqmal
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iqmal is derived from the Arabic root 'ق-م-ل' (Q-M-L), which conveys the meanings of completion, perfection, and consummation. While not explicitly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'Q-M-L' has deep connotations of completeness and integrity in actions and deeds. In Islamic tradition, Iqmal symbolizes the completion and perfection of various aspects, especially in worship and moral conduct. The name encourages individuals to strive for excellence and fulfillment in their endeavors.
